localWorkbench.profile: local metadata management only; backend-owned active instance not modified
localWorkbench.assemblyEntrypoint: python scripts/assemble-workbench.py --output <new-directory> (from pinned backend Git checkout)
localWorkbench.serviceCommandDirectory: actual assembled output; never this deployment checkout
localWorkbench.publisherDSNMode: explicit in-memory argument; no publisher environment variable
localWorkbench.sourceMode: one Git snapshot; generated manifest records export commit and code lock
